overlap.comparison: The same full-occurrence packing obeys general pointwise depth bounds and a sharp line formula. Those conclusions do not impose convexity of a level set in rank three.

Its different planar pentagon quantifies the change in an optimized packing after merging two capacities at their midpoint. The house-prism proof keeps the capacity table fixed and compares three distinct query points.

The generic full-occurrence packing dual is compatible with the prices used here. The explicit feasible prices and weak-duality inequality are proved directly and do not require this fact as a premise.

readability: The lattice completeness concerns the support of the abstract packing weights. The numerical weights are not asserted to be actual volumes of convex fibers.
